content.text: {"decision": "insufficient_evidence", "likely_cause": "", "fix": "", "cited_event_ids": ["124:a137", "115:a132", "119:a137", "134", "147", "155", "158:w174", "169", "172:w198"], "confidence": "low", "unsupported": ["The windows do not show the user leaving the cashflow report form without saving: in both sessions the last Portfolio edit is followed by a click on a control (session Scdc0bc9d at 9534 on a span; session S70833d65 at 11181 on the 'Run' span) and a coverage overlay, which may be a report run or submit rather than an abandonment.", "The visible error events (124:a137 in Scdc0bc9d; 115:a132 and 119:a137 in S70833d65) carry no field label or message text, so they cannot be attributed to a specific field such as Entity, As Of Date or Portfolio.", "No save action or form-submit event is present in the windows, so the 'without saving' part of the insight cannot be checked against the events.", "The windows cover only about 20 s around the event, so what happens after the overlays (whether the form is ever saved or revisited) is not visible.", "The meaning of the overlays (coverage shown/removed) and of the 'Run' control is not labelled in the events, so their role in the flow is inferred, not confirmed.", "Element-level detail for 'Portfolio' beyond the input_activity and click events (for example its validation rules or its required state) is not in the evidence.", "The median 9.8 s loss and the 6-of-6 abandonment figures are taken from the insight facts as given and were not re-derived from the windows, which show only two of the six sessions."]}
